_provenance: Copied from a separate designer's project at an Emergent code-server instance (password-protected VS Code web instance, /app/design_guidelines.json), reviewed and pulled in 2026-07-26. That project is a parallel prototype of the same product concept (per-trade generated sites + AI voice receptionist), explicitly targeted at WebStaffr per this file's own description field below. Reference material only -- not wired into any live code path. See docs/reference/README.md for what was and wasn't merged.
description: A grounded, high-contrast, no-nonsense aesthetic tailored for WebStaffr and its tradesmen audience. Prioritizes authority, immediacy, and trust.

color_palette.accent: Electric Blaze (#FF3B30) or Signal Orange (#EA580C) for action-oriented elements (Call Now, Book Appointment)
color_palette.rules: Color is function only. 95% of UI should be monochrome. Accent color exists solely to guide user action and highlight the Voice Chatbot.

rules: NO INTER or generic sans for headings.
Headings > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines MUST be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Max hero text size is text-6xl. Use fluid scaling.

layouts.hero: The 'Tetris' Grid (Asymmetry, Visual Tension). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Heavy emphasis on real photography without generic overlays.
layouts.trust_bar: Dense, compact grid. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 with subtle 1px border-separators.
layouts.services: Bento grid approach. col-span-4 for standard cards, col-span-8 for primary service.
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12 for containers. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8.

surfaces_and_visuals.header: Solid Background with hard bottom border (border-border/40). NO transparent headers over content.
surfaces_and_visuals.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, sharp or max 8px border-radius (rounded-md). Hover: -translate-y-1 shadow-lg.
surfaces_and_visuals.voice_bot: Use 'The Tracing Beam' surface strategy for the voice bot trigger/container to signal 'Active/Alive' technology.
surfaces_and_visuals.shadows: Minimalist. Use crisp edges, semi-transparent borders + subtle layered shadows on interaction.

components.navigation: Visible brand name + 3-5 links + primary CTA. Visible on desktop, NO hamburger menu on desktop. Fixed/Sticky requires z-50 and backdrop-blur-xl with bg-white/80.
components.forms: Shadcn components heavily customized to match the Swiss Brutalist look (thick 2px borders on focus, square or slightly rounded edges).
components.ctas: Sharp or slightly rounded buttons (rounded-md). High contrast (Accent color bg, white text). Include micro-animations on hover.
components.voice_chat: A sticky, high-contrast floating action component, or embedded in hero. Must have animated pulse or tracing beam border.

rules: Hover states on all interactive elements (must be a lighter hue of active state).
Focus states MUST have higher contrast.
Staggered entrance animations for service cards and testimonials.
NO universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).

images.strategy: Real tradesmen photos, before/after shots. Overlay max bg-black/30 or gradient to transparent.

urls.description: Roofers working - for roofing template hero
Electrician detail work - for electrical template hero
HVAC technician outdoors - for HVAC template hero
Team arriving at house - for 'Why Us' / Team section
Worker in helmet - for Owner/Story section

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
Never center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Never use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided URLs.
Create a solid, trustworthy, 'Swiss Brutalist' layout. Ensure the Voice Receptionist is a prominent, high-contrast feature.
Ensure 'THE PERFECT SITE BUILD CHECKLIST' is implemented in the templates (Hero, Trust Bar, Services, Why Us, Proof, Story, Local Presence, Lead Capture, Footer).
Ensure the voice bot is present on both the agency site and the generated tradesmen sites.
For .js files, stick to standard JS functionality, but follow UI/UX strictly.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (e.g., robot, brain).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Missing image categories MUST NOT default to placeholder text. Use relevant assets.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
